chunks: The man who believed said: "O my people, follow me; I will guide you to the right path."
ai.seo_question: Who is the believer that said 'O my people, follow me' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often attributed to Hashid, the believer from the family of Pharaoh, who courageously invited his people to follow his guidance to the path of success. It underscores the virtue of da'wah (invitation to God) and the responsibility of the faithful to lead others toward righteousness, even amidst a dominant culture of disbelief.
